summary_zh: 越南修訂投資法，目標簡化投資程序並強化供應鏈實質化，回應擴廠審批繁瑣的新痛點；Agribank下調現有貸款利率最多2.5%，緩解持續升溫的融資成本壓力。湄公河三角洲缺工、自動化技能人才不足仍是製造業持續面對的人力挑戰。
summary_en: Vietnam is amending its Investment Law to simplify procedures, addressing a new pain on slow expansion approvals. Agribank cut existing loan rates by up to 2.5%, easing rising financing costs. Labour shortages in the Mekong Delta and automation skill gaps persist.
